title: Alien Guardian of the Maze
description: A tall neon green alien with large pink eyes and a netted head covering stands in the foreground holding two patterned spheres. A long black serpent-like creature with a pink eye coils around its neck and arm while a smaller green dog with a pink eye and blue scarf stands beside it. Behind them is a complex black maze filled with bones, eyeballs, and unicorn horns under a swirling cosmic vortex containing outlined human figures.
